title: Wayfare Reserve Booking Terms by Ride Option
content:
Riders of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** can book some ride options ahead through Wayfare Reserve. The figures that govern a reserved trip are set per ride option.

| Term | Wayfare Shared | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Can be reserved | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Reservation fee | $0.00 | $3.00 | $3.00 | $4.00 | $4.00 | $5.00 | $7.00 |
| Shortest lead time before pickup (minutes) | 0 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 60 | 60 |
| Furthest ahead a pickup may be reserved (calendar days) | 0 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 90 | 90 |
| Free cancellation up to this many minutes before the reserved pickup time | 0 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 120 | 120 |
| Late cancellation fee | $0.00 | $10.00 | $10.00 | $15.00 | $15.00 | $25.00 | $35.00 |
| Reserved no-show fee | $0.00 | $10.00 | $10.00 | $15.00 | $15.00 | $25.00 | $35.00 |
| Driver-late threshold after the reserved pickup time (minutes) | 0 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Reservation fee refunded when no driver is found | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Dispatch cutoff after the reserved pickup time (minutes) | 0 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 | 15 |

## What each term means

- **Can be reserved**: whether the ride option can be booked ahead through Wayfare Reserve (true/false).
- **Reservation fee**: reservation fee charged when a reserved trip is booked, USD; $0.00 where reservations are not offered.
- **Shortest lead time**: shortest time between booking and the reserved pickup time, minutes; 0 where not offered.
- **Furthest ahead**: furthest ahead a pickup may be reserved, calendar days; 0 where not offered.
- **Free cancellation**: a reserved trip may be cancelled free at least this many minutes before the reserved pickup time; 0 where not offered.
- **Late cancellation fee**: fee for cancelling a reserved trip inside the free-cancel cutoff, USD; $0.00 where not offered.
- **Reserved no-show fee**: fee when a reserved rider is marked a no-show, USD; $0.00 where not offered.
- **Driver-late threshold**: if the driver of a reserved trip has not arrived this many minutes after the reserved pickup time, the rider may cancel free and the reservation fee is refunded, minutes.
- **Reservation fee refunded when no driver is found**: whether the reservation fee is refunded when no driver is found for a reserved trip (true/false).
- **Dispatch cutoff**: a reserved trip with no driver confirmed this many minutes after the reserved pickup time is closed as unfulfilled, minutes; 0 where not offered.

## Notes

- Wayfare Shared cannot be reserved; every reserved-trip figure for it is 0 or $0.00, while its refund-when-unfulfilled setting reads Yes.
- On every reservable ride option the late cancellation fee and the reserved no-show fee are the same figure.
